errors.text_span: започвайки от най-малката възрастова група в горния ляв ъгъл
errors.evidence: The description states that the clockwise arrangement starts from the top left corner with the smallest age group. However, the starting slice (14-17 age group, 5%) is located at the top right of the chart, not the top left.

errors.text_span: Секторът за възрастова група 14-17 е в тъмносин цвят
errors.evidence: The description states that the 14-17 age group sector is dark blue ("тъмносин"). In the chart, this sector (5%) is a medium blue. The dark blue color corresponds to the 65+ age group (14%).
The description identifies the 65+ age group sector as the largest. This is incorrect. The 65+ sector is 14%, while the largest sector is the 25-34 age group, which is 20%.

errors.text_span: а всички сектори са изобразени с еднаква дебелина
errors.evidence: The statement that all sectors are depicted with the same thickness is an over-generalization. Due to the 3D perspective, the sectors in the foreground appear visually thicker than those in the background.
